method: fixed K/D + surveyed planar checkerboard corners + solvePnP/refineLM; ground normal and height only; retain fixed horizontal camera offset/yaw
loaded_scope: unloaded rigid approximation only; no loaded accuracy inherited; VO gate must pass before full

replay.legacy_off: s1052 old RGB diagnostic only, cannot represent stiffness-on plant
replay.new_stiff_start: fixed own command prefix of seed1052, stationary <=12 SIM s; no dock prior
replay.detector_recovery: 8.25 s view >=6/96 valid columns; no gate changes
replay.global_localization: augmented_active_v1 uniform global, existing s2v29 gates retained
replay.ground_vo: normal pulse RMS nonincrease and carry RMSE strict improvement; no GT fit; stiffness-on records only for new-plant qualification

failure_policy: record failed/unevaluable gates; no full DEV or repeated loaded jig
